educational_overlay.purpose: Early-stage assessment of new features or data collection projects for privacy impact, consent mechanisms, and risk tier.
educational_overlay.when_to_use: During sprint planning, product requirement doc (PRD) reviews, or new customer onboarding workflows.
educational_overlay.when_not_to_use: When a full formal Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) has already been mandated by regulators.

variables.label: Data Collected
variables.default: Precise GPS coordinates, device ID, transaction history

educational_overlay.prompt_template:
Perform privacy risk triage for feature '{{FEATURE_NAME}}' collecting '{{DATA_CATEGORIES}}'.
Evaluate purpose limitation, data minimization, consent requirement, and sensitive data thresholds.
Classify overall privacy risk as LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH.
educational_overlay.fictional_scenario: A ride-hailing app plans to collect user location data continuously in the background even when the app is closed.
educational_overlay.sample_output:
### Privacy Triage: HIGH RISK
- **Issue**: Continuous background GPS collection without active ride booking violates data minimization.
- **Remediation**: Restrict GPS polling to foreground during active trips only.
guardrails: Explicit opt-in consent mandatory for precise location tracking.
verification_checklist: Verify SDK permissions in Android/iOS manifests.
educational_overlay.ai_risk_warning: AI cannot inspect actual binary network traffic to third-party ad networks.
